slides.headline: India's chip industry just had its busiest funding year yet.
SEMICON India 2026 opens in New Delhi
slides.body: The fifth edition of SEMICON India opens September 17 at Yashobhoomi, Dwarka, running through September 19 - over 600 exhibitors, roughly 300 international, delegations from 40+ countries.

slides.headline: 12 approved projects, over ₹1.64 lakh crore invested.
slides.body: It follows July 2026's approval of 'Semicon 2.0' - a ₹1,27,500 crore outlay building on Semicon 1.0's projects across Gujarat, Assam, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: Indian chip companies have raised nearly half their all-time funding since 2025 alone.
slides.body: India's semiconductor demand is projected to double from roughly $100 billion to $200 billion. The funding pace suggests investors are betting that build-out happens well before that ceiling is reached.
